response.query: What concrete integrated data schema and example record can map linguistic items to visual motifs and GIS coordinates, and what workload, cost estimates, milestones, and metrics will assess integration success?
response.answer: A concrete integrated data schema maps linguistic items to visual motifs and GIS coordinates using JSON format. Example record: {"item": "school", "motif": "building", "coordinates": {"lat": 34.2345, "long": -118.3456}}. Success assessed by workload completion, cost estimates, milestones, and metrics like accuracy and integration time.
